title: Inter's Pio Esposito scored Italy's third — has he earned the Parma start?
caption:
Inter striker Pio Esposito came off the bench in Bologna and scored Italy's third in a 3–1 win over Türkiye — his seventh goal in 13 caps, per Inter.it and the FIGC. Has he earned the start against Parma on Saturday?
